author: derek
reason: Acknowledge a KNOWN, EXPLAINED document staleness so the freshness guard stays loud about everything else. A guard that is permanently red is a guard nobody reads -- that is exactly how eleven projections stayed frozen from 2026-07-04 to 2026-07-30 while the rebuild reported ok. Each entry MUST carry name, watermark, reason and expires_at_ledger_head. The watermark PINS the exact value the acknowledgement was taken at: if the document's watermark moves at all -- forward but still stale, or backwards -- the acknowledgement stops applying and the document reports stale again, so an ack can never mask NEW drift. Expiry is measured against the LEDGER HEAD, never the wall clock, because 'now' in this lab is the newest fact it holds; there is no non-expiring acknowledgement. Only document checks are ackable: an entry naming 'bridge', 'corpus' or 'ledger' is a hard error, because those are the mechanical checks whose whole job is to catch the freeze -- run the bridge or fix the corpus instead of silencing it. Unlike corpus_regression_override.json this file is never rewritten automatically; check_freshness is a read-side reporter and stays side-effect-free, so expired entries are reported in ack_expired and pruned by hand. This exists so nobody widens --max-lag-hours to silence a true positive (ADR-0027).
